test_title: PYST 30: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'MAGNET' is written as 'BLOFUD'. How will 'PRAISE' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22c690a8f0ffeed0af7e31581d791d3f8784507047897b5bca5350233dcb5944.png] 

'MAGNET' is written as 'BLOFUD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d2a782d4a3517da6c053dabfb259e15601bc1d91ba53c01a936de9c6255c4df.png] 

Similarly,

'PRAISE' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f98b1d77a197f5a8e57592e06c5cdc43f683c25c7ca02a749ccb1ffe6ec59b2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "SOJZFR".
